mentions.name: SpellRush
mentions.description: A word game offering a unique take on the genre, designed to stand apart from the many Wordle-type clones. The concept was developed over recent months into a playable game seeking player feedback.
mentions.problem: Many modern word games are Wordle-type clones, so the author wanted to build an original take on the genre.
mentions.source_excerpt: I came up with the concept for SpellRush a few months ago and finally got it to what I think is a pretty fun concept over the past few weeks. Would love feedback from anyone that is up for giving it a try! https://spellrush.com/
